A three-page progress-billing invoice with grouped line-item sections, section subtotals, a carried-forward/brought-forward pair at the page 2/3 boundary, and a retainage-and-tax totals stack. Change the sections and their sums first — the summary table, carried-forward figure and totals must keep reconciling (data.json carries the chain). Deviations from the prototype, by engine policy: the running header is three margin boxes without the hairline beneath (margin-box borders do not render), and both continuation pages share one section label, 'Detail, sections A–E' (a per-page label via named pages currently leaves a trailing blank page).

**Engine features exercised:** @page :first, three running-header margin boxes, page counters, break-before: page, repeated &lt;thead>, grouped table sections with colspan, accent keyline subtotal rows.

Render it:

```bash
npx @formepdf/html templates/invoice-detailed/index.html -o invoice-detailed.pdf
```

```css style.css
/* invoice-detailed — page geometry and document-specific rules.
 * Spine comes from ../northmoor-shared.css. */

@page {
  size: Letter;
  margin: 52.5pt 57pt 40.5pt; /* 70px 76px 54px */
  @bottom-left {
    content: "Invoice INV-4421 · Kestrel Medical Center · Contract 2026-CS-04";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @bottom-right {
    content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
}

/* First-page 4px full-bleed accent head rule (escapes into the margin). */
.sheet { position: relative; }
.atop {
  position: absolute;
  top: -52.5pt;
  left: -57pt;
  right: -57pt;
  height: 3pt;
  background-color: #7B2233;
}
.meta-doc { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1.3fr 1fr 1fr; }
.sect-label { margin: 24pt 0 7.5pt; } /* 32px / 10px */
.twocol { display: flex; gap: 24pt; margin-top: 22.5pt; } /* 32px / 30px */
.scope { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 7.5pt; line-height: 1.65; }
.status { width: 195pt; } /* 260px */
.certline { border-top: 0.75pt solid #111111; width: 150pt; padding-top: 3.75pt; font-size: 6.375pt; margin-top: 9pt; }

/* Continuation pages: running header via three margin boxes, suppressed
 * on the first page; hairline rule on all three boxes (renders as one
 * continuous line); per-page section labels via the named pages below. */
@page {
  @top-left {
    content: "Northmoor · Invoice INV-4421";
    color: #7B2233;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
  @top-center {
    content: "Kestrel Medical Center — Contract 2026-CS-04";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
  @top-right {
    content: "Detail, sections A–E";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
}
@page :first {
  @top-left { content: none }
  @top-center { content: none }
  @top-right { content: none }
}
.p2 { page: detail-ac }
.p3 { break-before: page; page: detail-de }

/* Per-page section labels (the design's page-2/page-3 running headers).
 * Named pages carry the base geometry; only the @top-right band differs. */
@page detail-ac {
  @top-right {
    content: "Detail, sections A–C";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
}
@page detail-de {
  @top-right {
    content: "Detail, sections D–E and tax";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
}
```
